project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Emotional Vocal Focus

arrangement.notes: Sparse verses emphasize minimal instrumentation to highlight strong vocal hooks with emotional delivery. Sample layer uses modern chopping techniques such as slicing, gating, and stuttering.

event_markers.label: Start sparse verse stuttering
event_markers.reason: To create vocal-focused emphasis with textured sample chops

event_markers.label: Hook gate effect
event_markers.reason: To enhance hook energy with rhythmic gating

event_markers.label: Verse 2 slice effect
event_markers.reason: Maintain interest with subtle sample division

event_markers.label: Final hook chopped repeats
event_markers.reason: Intensify ending hook with repeated chops

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation with modern chopped drum hits
track_roles.bass: low-end support emphasizing groove in sparse verses
track_roles.chords: textural sampled chords sliced and gated for mood
track_roles.vocal: emotional vocal hooks and sparse verses focus
track_roles.fx: transitional effects using slicing and gating techniques

sensei_drum.brief: Generate and arrange drum parts using modern chopped drum hits matching sparse verses and strong hooks.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines that complement sparse verses and reinforce hook energy with groove emphasis.

harmony_generator.brief: Design chord textures using sliced and gated sampled chords for emotional and textural depth.

melody_generator.brief: Add background melodic phrases employing sample chopping techniques suitable for West Coast Hip-Hop.

ai_designer.brief: Manage overall arrangement focusing on sparse verses and strong vocal hooks with emotional impact.

presetor.brief: Apply presets tuned for modern sample chopping and West Coast Hip-Hop vibe.

songgps.brief: Ensure structured flow through intro, verses, hooks, bridge, and outro with appropriate energy curves.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed audio channels for mixing, preserving sample chop dynamics and vocal clarity.
